description: Réseau cyclable is a dataset listed in CANNES DATA open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Mairie de Cannes. Ce jeu de données est lié à la visualisation suivante: Visualisation - Réseau cyclable Réseau cyclable existant sur le territoire cannois. Ce réseau comprend les pistes et bandes cyclables, ainsi que les axes de circulation dont la vitesse est limitée, favorisant ainsi les déplacements en mode doux. Coverage: Cannes. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are Réseau, Cyclable, Mode doux, Déplacement. The portal shows 61 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-cannes-com-portal.
